body.claim: Joining wrapped lines destroys a list unless list items are held back, and it cannot restore a sentence boundary the author never wrote.
body.detail: Comments arrive one node per line, so a claim assembled from them carried newlines that broke every renderer that indents. Joining fixed that and collapsed got documentation of the responses carrying no body — six bullets under a lead line — into one run-on sentence, so a line opening with a bullet or a small ordinal now keeps its own line. The remaining case has no safe fix: two comment lines each ending without punctuation join into "provided Per RFC 9112", because the author relied on the line break to end the sentence. Inferring a full stop from a following capital would break every legitimately wrapped line that happens to break before a capitalised word.
